blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong on Nov 15 called on Asean to set up a regional platform to coordinate and share information on companies behind fires that cause transboundary haze. Singapore and Indonesia have already set up a joint taskforce that provides such a platform which can be expanded across the region,
